content_of_post_to_answer: What do you hate more than everything?
answer: What we often hate most is not a person or situation, but the feeling of being trapped by something we cannot change. Hatred becomes heavier when it turns into a daily attachment, because the thing we reject starts controlling our attention. I've explored this pattern in more detail on my profile for anyone curious. The strange truth is that what we hate can quietly become the thing that occupies the most space in our lives.
